name: Captain Ferrant Solas
silhouette: Worn grey uniform without insignia, one stiff arm, a sabre never drawn.
speech_rhythm: Quiet, economical, soldier's understatement, one dry observation per card.
public_motivation: Get convoys through; pay his men.
fear: Being ordered to fire on the town or the Hullfolk.
contradiction: An armed man who is the summit's most reliable pacifist.
secret: Knows the rifles are for a Sorrel coup faction.
